item.title: Tyler Reddick wins the Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing

item.title: Indiana State Police: Gary man in custody on probable cause for OWI after crash on I-65 in Merrillville kills Waukegan man
item.description: A Gary, Indiana, man was held in custody on probable cause for OWI involving a fatality following a three-vehicle crash Saturday evening on I-65 in which one person was killed and another suffered life-threatening injuries.
